reasons.why_not_transdiff: No public code. Paper exists; datasets are QTDB/LUDB, not PTB-XL. Substituting another generator is disallowed.
reasons.why_not_sediff: Public code requires unpublished prerequisites (latents, VAE/mini-decoder weights, simulator prior) plus OpenAI text embeddings. Fair from-scratch 4-class training on X_train is not supported without fabricating missing stages or using pretrained weights that may leak val/test patients. Published batch_size=4096 is also incompatible with 4 GB VRAM.
reasons.why_sssd: Only leakage-free runnable generator matching PTB-XL four-class 12-lead 100 Hz setup on 4 GB VRAM.

large_scale_prep.recommended_next: Increase sampling count for minority classes; keep train-only; then Week 5 quality assessment.

flowecg.reason: No public official implementation. GitHub repository search for FlowECG returned 0 repos. arXiv:2509.10491 and Hugging Face Papers list no code. Do not reimplement flow matching by editing the SSSD sampler. PPGFlowECG is a different method and was not substituted. Published 36x256 SSSD-sized backbone would also not fit 4 GB VRAM (~8.2 GB in the SSSD probe).

paper.title: FlowECG: Using Flow Matching to Create a More Efficient ECG Signal Generator

why_not_flowecg: No public official implementation. GitHub repository search for FlowECG returned 0 repos. arXiv:2509.10491 and Hugging Face Papers list no code. Do not reimplement flow matching by editing the SSSD sampler. PPGFlowECG is a different method and was not substituted. Published 36x256 SSSD-sized backbone would also not fit 4 GB VRAM (~8.2 GB in the SSSD probe).
